node.html:
Built and maintained Helios, a Rails 7 workflow platform for US healthcare language services, managing the full project lifecycle from intake to delivery.

The platform covers medical project setup, multilingual file workflows, duplicate-file checks, turnaround-time and line-item pricing calculations, vendor/work-order orchestration, invoicing, and client delivery communication.

It integrates with external healthcare/client systems and vendor portals (including ACI/AIMS and RICAS), and uses Pundit for role-based access control, Doorkeeper for OAuth2 authentication, PublicActivity for audit trails, ActionCable for real-time operational updates, and Sidekiq for asynchronous background processing.
